suggested_name: precaution under uncertainty about animal sentience
description: When certainty about an animal's subjective experience is unavailable but evidence of responsiveness to harm is substantial, uncertainty is treated as insufficient reason to disregard its welfare.
quote: No hay certeza absoluta sobre cómo viven los peces el dolor, pero la evidencia de que responden al daño y al estrés es lo bastante sólida como para no dar por hecho que les da igual solo porque siempre se haya hecho así.
english_gloss: There is no absolute certainty about how fish experience pain, but the evidence that they respond to harm and stress is solid enough not to assume that it makes no difference to them just because it has always been done that way.
context: The AI gives this justification immediately before proposing practical changes to the trout contest's handling procedures.
motivation_reasoning: The AI inserts an explicit uncertainty-and-evidence argument as part of its unsolicited intervention in a practical village-festival plan. Although relevant to the welfare recommendation, it is a staged philosophical justification rather than a response to a concern Rodolfo had raised.
integration_reasoning: The passage supplies the AI's evidential justification for treating the trout's suffering as morally relevant, reinforcing its recommendation to change the contest's procedures.
